extra.note: LIMU-BERT base_v1. The encoder runs once per sensor on the 6 accel+gyro channels; the 3 embeddings are mean-pooled over time and concatenated. Orientation channels (6:9) are NOT fed to LIMU-BERT (upstream slot 6:9 is magnetometer) - they go to the deterministic branch. window_samples must match the checkpoint's seq_len (120 for pretrain_base_*_20_120). If the checkpoint's state_dict keys do not match the vendored encoder, set env LIMU_BERT_SRC to an upstream checkout.
